items.title: Business case
items.body: The business case is not ready yet. This section will capture the internal justification — quantified value, cost comparison, and strategic rationale — once finalized with the deal team.

items.title: Demo environment
items.body: The governed Vercel org and reference architecture an enterprise tests against. Every environment below inherits SSO via Vercel Passport, private data access through Vercel Connect, and source protection through GitHub.

items.title: Procurement
items.body: We work with procurement across commercials, security, and legal. Documents are versioned, each version carries a what-is-new summary and a redline change list against the prior version.

items.title: Technical POC
items.body: The technical proof of concept covers the demo environment, POC users, success criteria, and a competitor-informed capability map.
